verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a self-hosted TypeScript authentication and authorization framework. User-configured autonomous background automations are an automation or agent-platform capability, not an axis buyers compare auth libraries on. Its agent-related features (MCP auth, token exchange, agent delegation) cover authorizing agents, not running automations, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships a background automation or scheduling feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
